debt_definition.asserts_a_field_equals_a_constant_or_a_f: an assertion compares a payload value with a literal or a frozen vocabulary
debt_definition.asserts_a_field_is_present_without_compa: an assertion tests a payload value for truth without comparing it
debt_definition.compares_the_face_with_a_copy_of_itself_: the only comparisons put payload reads on both sides -- the face is compared with a copy of itself and no field is read
debt_definition.only_requires_the_file_to_exist: no assertion touches a payload value: the block only needs the file
debt_definition.re_derives_a_number_from_the_payload: an assertion compares a payload value with a value this block builds itself (a call that is not a payload access)
debt_definition.reads_the_file_and_reads_no_field_in_thi: the block opens the file but binds no payload in the block: a shim that hands the bytes on, or a leg that only compares bytes
debt_definition.the_source_is_absent_or_does_not_parse: the source is absent from this tree or does not parse

method_limits: the population is E479's own residue class, inherited not re-measured: a reader E479 missed is not in this study either
a site is classified by its asserting block, so a block that asserts on two different faces gives both sites the same class
an assertion built from a call is read as a re-derivation; whether that call actually rebuilds the face is not executable here
M_INDIRECT sites are named, not classified: following a helper parameter is another study
a deleted or renamed source is published as unreadable rather than assumed unchanged

mode_definition.hands_the_path_to_a_helper_that_opens_it: the site names the path but no open call carries that line -- the path is handed to a helper that opens it, which this build cannot follow, so it is published rather than folded into a class
mode_definition.opens_it_for_reading: the site calls open() without a write-mode, or a json load / text read on a handle it opened at that line
mode_definition.opens_it_for_writing: the site calls open() with a mode that can write (w/a/x/+)

role_definition.a_one_off_round_script: a one-off round script (leading underscore or under results/)
role_definition.a_standalone_leg_runner: scripts/run_e*_smoke_leg.py -- a leg extracted and run standalone
role_definition.the_smoke_suite: smoke_test.py -- a leg in the full suite
